BrochureContent.Content:
Constructed in the mid to late 1950s, this two-storey detached residence on a site of circa 0.99 acres offers an exciting opportunity for purchasers seeking a home with character and significant scope for upgrading. The property benefits from double-glazed PVC windows to the first floor, with original teak windows at ground floor level, providing clear potential for modernization and energy upgrades. An oil-fired central heating system services the house.  

The property enjoys a highly accessible yet scenic setting on the western outskirts of Waterford, approximately 6 km from the city centre and with easy access to the Outer Ring Road. Situated along the Old Kilmeaden Road, the property also benefits from convenient access to the N25 and M9 road networks. 
The area is well served by local amenities, with SETU Arena, UPMC Whitfield Hospital, Butlerstown Retail Park and Mount Congreve Gardens all located within a short drive. The renowned Waterford Greenway is nearby, offering over 45km of walking and cycling routes through some of the county's most attractive countryside.

Although the property is presented in a dated condition, it provides a solid and well-established base for refurbishment, offering an ideal blank canvas for an incoming purchaser to create a comfortable and contemporary family home tailored to their own style.
